## Overall Learning 

During the Cyber Security Internship at SURE ProEd, I gained practical knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, Machine Learning, and Security Operations Center (SOC) workflows. I learned how intrusion detection systems monitor network traffic, classify malicious activities, and generate security alerts in real time.
I developed hands-on experience in Python programming, Flask backend development, REST API implementation, Machine Learning model integration, dashboard development, report generation, and cybersecurity monitoring. The internship also enhanced my problem-solving, debugging, documentation, teamwork, and software development skills by working on a real-world AI-powered Intrusion Detection System project.

<!-- Project 1 -->
<h3 id="project1">Project 1: <!-- Add Project Title --></h3>
<p>
  The AI-Based Intrusion Detection System (AI IDS) is a machine learning-powered cybersecurity solution that monitors network traffic and detects malicious activities in real time. It classifies network packets as Normal or Attack using a trained Machine Learning model and assigns severity levels based on prediction confidence. The system provides an interactive Security Operations Center (SOC) dashboard for monitoring alerts, traffic analytics, and threat sources. It also supports CSV/PDF report generation and Email/Telegram notifications for critical security incidents. The project enhances network security by enabling faster, accurate, and automated threat detection.
</p>

## **Learnings from LST and SST**

The LST (Life Skills Training) and SST (Soft Skills Training) sessions helped me improve both my personal and professional development. I learned effective communication, teamwork, leadership, time management, problem-solving, presentation skills, interview preparation, and workplace ethics.
These sessions increased my confidence in expressing ideas, collaborating with team members, and handling real-world challenges. They also prepared me for professional environments by improving my interpersonal and decision-making skills.
